title: Stoner Dark green
description: the green edition of stoner a selected bottoms
body:
Welcome to the fresh Green Edition of the Stoner Dark project! In this version (v1.14.6), we have redesigned the GUI to provide a sleek, dark aesthetic accented with vibrant lime green highlights for a refreshing visual experience.
Key Features in this Version:

    Selected Colored Buttons: Key interface buttons, such as Minecraft Realms, have been customized with a striking lime green color to provide a strong visual contrast.

    UI Enhancements: Updated textures for AppleSkin, Mod Menu buttons, and improved inventory management layouts.

    Special Update Support: Full compatibility for the "Potato" April Fools' update and modern versions like 1.21.x and 26.x.

    Custom Icons: Unique icons next to the Options and Quit Game buttons to enhance the pack's visual identity.

Compatibility

This pack is designed to work seamlessly on:

    Minecraft 1.21.x and newer.

    Recent Snapshots including 26.1.2.

    Support for the Craftmine version and 25w14 updates.

Why Choose Stoner Dark?

This project is part of a growing series with 5 projects and over 90 downloads. We focus on delivering a GUI that is simple, easy on the eyes, and professionally designed for technical players.

    Tip: Look for the color-coded filename in your resource pack menu: §e§ Stoner!_Dark v1.14.6 §a§ green.zip.

Developed by: Oidal
Follow the project on Modrinth for upcoming color variants including Orange and Purple!
